# Provenance-bearing SearchResult objects

Search functions return SearchResult dataclass instances containing slug, entity_type, name, score, payload, and anchors. The helper _result normalizes anchors to an empty list when absent to guarantee provenance fields are present.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/retrieval/search.py` — `knowledge_compiler.retrieval.search.SearchResult`
